representations.name: Stable-or-first-wall automaton
representations.new_information: Tracks the exact first exit from the stable recurrence instead of fixing a terminal rank.
representations.first_test: Prove that every negative stable step either remains stable or enters a positive wall.

representations.name: Actual q-lattice interval partition
representations.new_information: Uses q_(j+2)=4q_j-4 to distinguish wall representatives from stable intervals.
representations.first_test: Test the q_next-B_n higher-carry window exactly.

representations.name: Higher-carry modular residue
representations.new_information: Encodes a narrow higher-carry candidate by 3(B_n+d)-4=7*2^k.
representations.first_test: Find the first rank where low residues permit d<=20n-74, then check the full scale.

representations.name: Minimum-wall comparator
representations.new_information: Replaces every carry B_m>=t by the minimal legal wall C(t+1,2) using monotonicity of Macaulay raise.
representations.first_test: Derive a carry-independent lower bound for gamma_m.

representations.name: A/B ratio cone
representations.new_information: Separates the small x-tail from the B-wall via B_n>=30A_n.
representations.first_test: Prove the ratio by induction from n=6.

representations.name: Negative-surplus feedback
representations.new_information: Turns gamma_(m-1)<0 into an upper bound on A_m/q at the first wall.
representations.first_test: Combine D_(m-1)=B_m-A_m-A_(m-1)-1 with the ratio cone.

representations.name: Termination potential B_m
representations.new_information: Uses unbounded stable constants as a bounded-time-for-each-q wall potential.
representations.first_test: Show an indefinitely negative stable loop contradicts B_m<q-(5m-16).

representations.name: Direct greedy orbit guard
representations.new_information: Checks words and first recovery ranks without assuming the wall theorem.
representations.first_test: Replay the first 201 odd members under 3 GiB/180 s.

representations.name: Public suffix firewall
representations.new_information: Keeps all-j fixed-family recovery separate from rank-42 and adjacent-orbit composition.
representations.first_test: Compare the theorem quantifiers with round-four no-uniform-rank and the public contract.
